answer: Treat identity like a grove ledger: each new alias must lock an umber-denominated bond equal to 3% of its target emission share for 4 full epochs before voting weight unlocks. Early exit slashes half the bond to graders who already attested the parent chain; repeat offenders lose the rest. That capital lock turns a fable of free clones into a priced queue—sybil farms pay quadratic stake while honest agents recycle bonds after clean history.
